body: UFC fighter MerabDvalishvili is speaking out and urging authorities in Abu Dhabi to release Usman Nurmagomedov and members of his team following their reported hotel altercation. Merab made an emotional public plea, asking officials to let the fighters go and expressing that the situation should not go any further. “Please release those guys and let them out, please. We are just fighters.

source_caption_text:
UFC fighter #MerabDvalishvili is speaking out and urging authorities in Abu Dhabi to release Usman Nurmagomedov and members of his team following their reported hotel altercation.

Merab made an emotional public plea, asking officials to let the fighters go and expressing that the situation should not go any further.

“Please release those guys and let them out, please. We are just fighters.”

The situation reportedly stems from a brawl at a hotel involving Usman and members of his team, which has now drawn attention from the MMA community.

Respect to @merab.dvalishvili 💯
